text.en:
Barrio Guisit in the municipality of Lapog, of; Guisit, barrio of, province of Ilocos Sur,
Philippine Islands, shall hereafter be called Barrio San Isidro.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 6, 1935.
